title: Yehudah Mar bar Mareimar
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yehudah Mar bar Mareimar was a prominent scholar in Rav Papa’s time and a student of Rava. In [Ketubot 80b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.80b.1-3), he gave a ruling in Rava’s name, and Rav Papa explained that Yehudah’s ruling was inferred from Rava’s conduct. When Rav Papa went to Abba of Sura to write a ketubah for his son, Yehudah [Mar] bar Mareimar came out, and Rav Papa said, “Come in with me.” Abba of Sura assigned all his property to his daughter. Hyman cites this at [Ketubot 53a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.53a.1-3). Hyman cites Bava Metzia 101a for Yehudah [Mar, according to Dikdukei Soferim] bar Mareimar telling his servant, “Hire for me,” and so on. The passage is in [Bava Metzia 111a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.111a.3).[^1]

notes.text: The visit opens at [Ketubot 52b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.52b.18), which names Yehudah bar Mareimar, and continues on 53a. The instructions to hire workers occur at Bava Metzia 111a, also without Mar in Davidson. Hyman’s apparatus attribution is retained. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1710&lang=en) compares the ketubah and Rava notices.
